title: Dugway chief scientist reveals a huge subterranean facility and its shed entrance
place_text: west of Granite Peak, Dugway Proving Ground, Utah

tellings.quote: who informed this individual MS of the massive stiff or subterranean facility below Dougway

plain: A huge underground facility lies beneath Dugway Proving Ground, an Army testing range in Utah, and is entered through a shed west of Granite Peak, according to a researcher who posts as UAPGerb. He says the base's chief scientist told this to a person he identifies only as MS. If true, it would put a large hidden site under a known military range.
